- Initial release of the maxpreps skill, enabling access to US high school sports data from MaxPreps.com.
- Allows searching for schools and athletes, and retrieving team schedules, scores, records, rosters, stats, rankings, and athlete career data.
- Simple CLI workflow using Node.js script (`mpx.mjs`), requiring no authentication or API keys.
- Supports flexible data retrieval with specific commands for each data type (schedule, roster, stats, etc.).
- Handles MaxPreps' rapid buildId rotation, corrects for out-of-season/incomplete data, and filters out soft-deleted roster and contest entries by default.
- Provides guidance for correctly resolving canonical team and season paths; supports fetching up to 20 years of sports history.
